
usage:
  plat script <flags>
optional flags:
  -f:<filePath>            reads the script from the given file, instead
                             of from standard input
  -echo                    echo commands read from the script
usage:
  -?                       same as -usage
  -help                    same as -usage
  -locale:<x>              set the default locale (en_US)
  -@<option>               pass option to Java VM
  -buildreg                force rebuild of the registry
